title: Children Peeling Eggs at Outdoor Picnic Table, 1968 Backyard Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot from 1968 showing a group of young children gathered outdoors around a checkered picnic table. The children, dressed in mid-1960s summer or springtime party dresses with lace collars, bows, and headbands, are busily peeling hard-boiled eggs from a large metal bowl, likely for an Easter celebration, picnic, or family backyard gathering. Several smaller bowls containing berries and treats are also spread across the table.
